subject: Demo request + fit questions — Nephos AI
messages:
From: Samira Ahmed <samira@nephos.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — exploring Redwood for RAG

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks — I signed up via the self-serve flow earlier and wanted to follow up with a bit more context so we can scope a demo. Quick answers to the intake questions: 

- Use case: We want to add retrieval-augmented generation to our support search (ticket summarization + suggested KB snippets). Primary goal is higher resolution on the first-touch response.
- Volume: ~12k support queries/day across clients today; peak concurrency for inference is ~120 req/s during our morning spike.
- Inputs: Avg prompt ~220 tokens, expected response ~120 tokens.
- Timeline: Proof-of-concept in Q2 (pilot with 3 customers), aim for production by Q3 if pilot looks good.
- Data sensitivity: contains PII; SOC2 / audit logs and retention controls required. I attached our security checklist.
- Preferred demo timezone: PST (UTC-8).

Happy to hop on a 30-minute demo to see latency/cost tradeoffs + integration patterns.

Best,
Samira Ahmed
Head of Platform, Nephos AI
samira@nephos.ai

Attachment: Nephos-Security-Reqs.pdf (security checklist)

Hi Samira — really helpful context, thanks for sending that over and for attaching the security checklist. A couple quick clarifying questions so Marissa and I can tailor the demo: 

- Can you confirm the 120 req/s is sustained or bursty (e.g., 2-3 minute spikes)?
- Do you expect most inference to be on single-turn prompts, or will you be holding conversation state?
- Any constraints on outbound network egress (we have private deployment options if you need no egress).

I can run a quick 30-minute walkthrough next week. Are you available for either:
- Mon 2026-03-15 10:00–10:30 PT
- Mon 2026-03-15 14:00–14:30 PT

If those don't work, tell me a couple windows that do and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Demo request — exploring Redwood for RAG

Hi Priyom — thanks. Quick answers: the 120 req/s is a 10–20 minute burst during daily morning syncs (so it's fairly spiky). Mostly stateless single-turn inference for now (we may add light context windows later). No outbound egress restrictions at the PoC stage but we will require audit logs and token retention policies when we go to production.

The 14:00 slot would work better for me if that's still open. If Marissa prefers the morning we can be flexible.

Samira
